issue_title: [Feature] Add file lock mechanism for safe concurrent multi-process writes

implementation_summary.approach: Added optional file locking via use_locking constructor parameter with cross-platform support (fcntl on Unix, msvcrt on Windows)
key_changes: Added use_locking parameter to TodoStorage.__init__ (default False for backward compatibility)
Implemented _acquire_lock() context manager using fcntl.flock (Unix) or msvcrt.locking (Windows)
Wrapped save() operation with file lock when use_locking=True
Added comprehensive test suite for file locking feature

risks_and_limitations: File locking is advisory on Unix - only protects against other processes using the same locking mechanism
Lock file (.json.lock) is created alongside the data file - may need cleanup in some scenarios
Windows msvcrt.locking with LK_LOCK blocks indefinitely - could hang if lock is never released
